paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 1, end of section 15. Hyman reports that there, at 4:1, he speaks to Rabbi Aivu. Bereshit Rabbah 33:6 reads Rav Bivi and not Rabbi Trayya; Vayikra Rabbah 31:10 reads Rabbi Berekhyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15 has the form רבי טריי and has Rabbi Aivu replying to him. Hyman’s separate 4:1 statement is retained; the sequence at 1:15 is not silently substituted for every cited occurrence.

The checked Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15 and 4:1 both name Trayyi and have Rabbi Aivu replying to him. Bereshit Rabbah 33:6 has Rav Beivai and Rabbi Abbahu’s reply; Vayikra Rabbah 31:10 has Rabbi Berekhyah and Rabbi Aivu’s reply. Hyman’s separate statement that Trayya speaks to Aivu at 4:1 is retained as his account, with the differing digital dialogue direction explicit and no merged speaker identity.
